description:
modules/enrollment with modules/traegerview — GET
/traeger/holiday-periods/{id}/registrations/known-children (#6683, ADR
0214): in the Träger projection's administrative transaction the Träger
row, its school IDs, the registered children of the period at Enrollment,
their namesakes at People Directory and the roster of the schools with a
namesake at School Membership; then in the Träger transaction its binding
and the period with its weeks and time models; the trail entry writes but
selects nothing. Flat in the number of children and schools.
